item.title: ETH ETFs Surge Amid Heavy Selling
item.description:
ETH ETFs Surge Amid Heavy Selling

Two tapes printed at once, and they do not agree. Ethereum spot ETFs logged over $1.5 billion in net inflows across roughly twelve sessions since mid-August, a regulated-wrapper bid large enough to dominate any ordinary flow week. Arkham data shows BlackRock’s ETHA alone buying about $1.02 billion in nine days without a net-selling day. On the same market, Binance’s ETH taker buy/sell ratio sank to 0.81, one of the most extreme sell-side readings on record, meaning aggressive market sells outpaced buys by roughly 23%. ETH itself traded just under the $2,500 round number in a $2,383–$2,530 range, while large-wallet cost basis clustered near $2.26k–$2.35k.
